punchline: By Brown's definitions, envy has two people in it and jealousy has three.
thirty_sec: In Atlas of the Heart, Brené Brown separates two words we blur. Envy is wanting something another person has, like looks, status or wealth. Jealousy is fearing the loss of a relationship you already have, and it usually has a third person in it. Counting the people in the picture tells you which feeling you have.
